skills.description: An enterprise training-needs diagnosis framework distilled from 21 years of multinational-corporation L&D experience. Typical triggers include "帮我做培训需求诊断", "评估我们公司的培训现状", "培训体系 AI 化在哪里切入", or requests for a training gap analysis with an AI opportunity map and ROI estimate.
